Description.description: Job definition for the Spaarke.Scheduling background-job framework (R3 Part 2). Read by ScheduledJobHost on startup + hourly refresh. Per-run audit history lives in sprk_backgroundjobrun. Distinct from sprk_processingjob, which is Office-scoped — do NOT overload that entity.

Handler-specific configuration JSON. Schema is owned by the handler (IScheduledJob). E.g., MembershipReconciliationJob may consume batch size + entity scope.
Standard 5-field cron expression (e.g., '0 2 * * *' for nightly 02:00). Parsed by the Cronos NuGet at startup. Empty/null means the job only runs via manual trigger.
Human-readable description of what the job does. Surfaced in the admin endpoints + maker portal.
Human-readable job name (primary name field). E.g., 'Membership Reconciliation'.
Master enable/disable. When false, ScheduledJobHost does not start a timer for this job. Toggleable at runtime via POST /api/admin/jobs/{jobId}/enable|disable.
Master enable/disable. When false, ScheduledJobHost does not start a timer for this job. Toggleable at runtime via POST /api/admin/jobs/{jobId}/enable|disable.
Fully-qualified C# class name (e.g., 'Spaarke.Scheduling.MembershipReconciliationJob'). Resolved at ScheduledJobHost startup via reflection + DI.
Stable string identifier for the job (e.g., 'membership-reconciliation'). Unique key — used by ScheduledJobHost + admin endpoints to address jobs without GUIDs.
Denormalized from the most recent sprk_backgroundjobrun.sprk_completedon. Updated by ScheduledJobHost when a run finishes.
Truncated error message from the most recent failed run (full detail in sprk_backgroundjobrun.sprk_errormessage). Cleared on next successful run.
Denormalized from the most recent sprk_backgroundjobrun.sprk_startedon. Updated by ScheduledJobHost when a run starts. Lets list views show last-run time without joining.
Status of the most recent run (denormalized from sprk_backgroundjobrun). Success=1, Failed=2, Running=3, Cancelled=4.
